title: Note: agents can now add tabs to any page live, including a session's own page

chat.text: The page tool works for real (merged into dev). An agent sends a path and a raw JSON delta; a new tab, a layout change or an item appears on every open tab with no reload (about 150 ms). Every session page now reads its own page.jsonl on top of the default template, so "add a Now tab here" shows up beside Conversation. Screenshot: ![Now tab added live](/framework/ai/2026-10-09/page-mastermind/demo-now-1920.png). Live demo: /framework/core/Page/tool/. Design: /framework/core/Page/doc/architecture.md (also records two decisions from 18:58 and 19:05: drawers belong to the page, and one core Session class). How a line streams: /framework/core/Page/doc/streaming.md. Also fixed on the way: core/Page's Overview, Files and Settings tabs (and every Doc page's Files tab) had been hidden since 10-03 by a List name guard; they are back. Caveat: Servex still runs the old page tool until its next restart.
